21.description: Future city initiatives for 2025 on service, savings, and sustainability were approved.

25.description: The city will continue its Community Safety Program, a partnership framework coordinating responses to safety pressures around shelters and drop-in centers. A delegate highlighted the quadrupled homelessness crisis and urged immediate emergency responses alongside long-term strategies.

chips.text: Toby Esterby stated April had over 700 overdose responses, more than during a provincial emergency.
Specific crime data numbers for social disorder around shelters were requested but not provided.
Saskatoon has a large Indigenous population with significantly limited supports.

23.description: Saskatoon City Council received an update on the progress made towards the 2022-2025 Strategic Plan.

24.description: Saskatoon will invest in managing its infrastructure and corporate assets.

19.description: Council received verbal updates from its members, the FCM/SUMA, and various boards, committees, and commissions.
